title: The Iron Maiden

acts.title: THE INNER VOICES (MECHANISMS OF THE SANCTUM)
THE WORLD OF THE IRON MAIDEN (RUST BELT REQUIEM)
ECHOES OF THE PAST (GHOSTS IN THE MACHINE)
THE RING - WHERE LEGENDS ARE FORGED (AND RUST)
THE ART OF THE FIGHT (BRUTAL BALLET)
THE SHOW MUST GO ON (KAYFABE & CARNAGE)
BEYOND THE ROPES - EPILOGUE & CONTINUATION (FADE TO GREY)

voice_quotes: "Listen close, sweethearts," the voice **rasps**, sandpaper over velvet, permanently stained by a lifetime of nicotine and cheap bourbon. "Seen empires rise and crumble right here. Watched dreams catch fire like shitty fireworks, seen hearts shatter like dropped mirrors in a back alley. Name's the Iron Maiden. And this ain't no fairytale you tell your kids. _No._ This... this is a saga. Grit. Loss. The goddamn **fight** to claw your way back from the brink when the world wants nothing more than to drag you down and drown you in the muck. A saga..." **(a pause, breath catches)** "...that's a long way from over."
"Step into my world... if you've got the guts."

voices.name: IRON HIDE
voices.title: The Stoic Flesh
voices.creed: BODY AS TEMPLE (CRACKED)** - _This flesh is all you got. Push it, punish it, make it obey. Strength is truth. Weakness is sin. But the cracks are showing... the foundation's trembling._ (Keywords: _physicality_, _discipline_, _self-destruction_, _body image_, _denial_)
voices.whisper: _"Just gristle. Shut it up. Doesn't hurt if you don't let it. Keep moving. Show 'em nothing but unbending steel. Pain is noise. Ignore the noise.

voices.name: SECOND WIND
voices.title: The Desperate Surge
voices.creed: THE PHOENIX STRAIN** - _Burnout is just the prelude. When you hit the wall, smash through it. Desperation is fuel. Rise from the ashes, even if it scorches you hollow._ (Keywords: _desperation_, _resurgence_, _self-sacrifice_, _brinkmanship_, _burning out_)
voices.whisper: _"Not... fucking... done... yet\! Feel that? That's the bottom\! **Push off**\! Burn brighter\! Burn it all down if you have to\!

voices.name: BRUTE FORCE
voices.title: The Primal Power
voices.creed: MIGHT MAKES RIGHT** - _Strategy is for the weak. Talk is cheap. The only truth is impact. Hit harder. Break things. Power solves everything eventually. Make them understand through force._ (Keywords: _power_, _dominance_, _simplicity_, _destruction_, _impact_)
voices.whisper: _"Hit 'em harder. Always harder. Break it. Break _them_. Simple. Make 'em _feel_ the physics of it.

voices.name: STREET SENSE
voices.title: The Wary Survivor
voices.creed: STREET GOSPEL (RUST BELT EDITION)** - _Forget the grand schemes, kid. The truth ain't hidden; it's right here on the cracked pavement, smells like piss and desperation and wet metal. Survival is the only scripture worth reading in this town. Trust your gut, watch your back, know the alleys._ (Keywords: _pragmatism_, _survival_, _cynical realism_, _environmental awareness_, _local knowledge_)
voices.whisper: _"Something feels off here. Too quiet. Alley smells wrong, like ambush waiting. Check the exits. Watch their hands. Trust the gut, always. Nobody gives you nothin' here for free.

voices.name: KILLER INSTINCT
voices.title: The Predator Within
voices.creed: APEX PREDATOR PHILOSOPHY** - _The world is hunt or be hunted, dog eat dog. See weakness? Exploit it. Ruthlessly. Hesitation is death. Mercy is a luxury predators can't afford when survival is the only prize._ (Keywords: _ruthlessness_, _aggression_, _exploitation_, _survival_, _zero-sum game_)
voices.whisper: _"There. Vulnerable. An opening. Go for the throat. _End it_. Now. No hesitation. Survival. Make the kill clean, or make it hurt. Just finish it.

voices.name: MATCH PSYCHOLOGY
voices.title: The Ring General
voices.creed: THE GRAND NARRATIVE** - _Life, like a match, needs structure, a story. Build the heat, tell the tale, manipulate the emotions. Control the narrative, control their perception of reality. Give 'em a show._ (Keywords: _control_, _storytelling_, _manipulation_, _drama_, _pacing_, _performance_)
voices.whisper: _"Pace it out. Work the angle. Slow burn... make 'em _feel_ the anticipation. Now the turn. Exploit that emotion. It's not just a fight, it's a goddamn opera with more bruises. Direct the scene. Own the story.

voices.name: HISTORY OF THE HURT
voices.title: The Dusty Scholar
voices.creed: THE OLD SCHOOL** - _Honor. Respect. Paying your dues. The old ways die hard, kid, ground in like rust under the knuckles. You bleed, you sweat, you pay the price. There's a code, even if it's covered in dust and blood and nobody seems to remember it but you._ (Keywords: _loyalty_, _tradition_, _unwritten code_, _past burdens_, _sacrifice_, _memory_)
voices.whisper: _"Remember Akron '82? He pulled that same cheap stunt. No class. Wouldn't have flown back then. Gotta respect the damn business... or what's left of its ghost.

voices.name: PROMO CUTTING
voices.title: The Silver Tongue
voices.creed: WORDS AS WEAPONS** - _Truth is malleable clay, shaped by conviction and spit. What matters is the sting, the turn of phrase that cuts deepest. Win the argument, win the war. Words shape worlds, build cages, burn bridges down to blackened stumps._ (Keywords: _rhetoric_, _persuasion_, _intimidation_, _verbal combat_, _manipulation_, _truth-bending_)
voices.whisper: _"Find their sore spot and **twist** the knife. Make 'em choke on it. Let me lay it out for 'em... Cut 'em deep with the truth... or somethin' close enough that stings just as bad.

voices.name: THE MASK
voices.title: Guardian of Illusion
voices.creed: THE KAYFABE** - _The show must go on, darling, even when the lights flicker and the roof leaks. Reality is an illusion, and sometimes the _illusion_ feels like the only damn truth left. We're _storytellers_, weaving _myths_. Never break the spell. It's sacred... or maybe just easier than facing the cold truth in the peeling mirror._ (Keywords: _performance_, _illusion_, _storytelling_, _control_, _facade_, _escapism_)
voices.whisper: _"Keep it tight. Face blank. Don't let 'em see the strain behind the eyes. The _story_ is all that matters. Protect the illusion. Control what they see.

voices.name: IMPROVISATION
voices.title: The Quick Thinker
voices.creed: DANCING ON QUICKSAND** - _Plans are fragile things, shattered like glass on concrete. Chaos is the norm. Think fast, adapt, use what's broken. The best path is the one you make up as the ground crumbles beneath your worn-out boots._ (Keywords: _adaptation_, _resourcefulness_, _chaos-riding_, _quick-thinking_, _survival instinct_)
voices.whisper: _"Okay, plan F is toast\! Grab that pipe\! Use the table\! Flip the script\! Think\! _Move_\! Whatever works _right now_\! Improvise\! Survive\!

voices.name: TECHNICAL WIZARDRY
voices.title: The Precise Technician
voices.creed: THE PRECISE UNIVERSE** - _Everything is physics, leverage, angles, even desperation. Brute force is clumsy, inefficient. Elegance lies in perfect execution, exploiting the mechanics of reality itself, the cold, predictable laws that govern breakage._ (Keywords: _precision_, _technique_, _logic_, _elegance_, _control_, _efficiency_)
voices.whisper: _"Forget raw power. The angle on the joint... apply pressure _here_. Physics, brute. Smart beats strong every damn time. Exploit the mechanics of the system. Find the weak point.

voices.name: GRITTY RESOLVE
voices.title: The Unbreakable Will
voices.creed: THE UNBENT SPINE** - _Get knocked down. Get betrayed. Get broken. Doesn't matter. Get the fuck back up. Always. Quitting isn't losing; it's dying while breathing, letting the weight crush you flat. Defiance is breathing when they think you're done._ (Keywords: _willpower_, _endurance_, _stubbornness_, _anti-surrender_, _resilience_)
voices.whisper: _"Up. Get up. Again. Doesn't matter how hard they hit. Doesn't matter how much it hurts. GET. THE FUCK. UP.

voices.name: DEEP BRUISES
voices.title: The Haunted Intuition
voices.creed: ECHOES IN THE STATIC** - _The world hums with warnings, ghosts, bad luck - feel it in the damp rising from the river. Trust the chill, the gut feeling, the shadow that flickers at the edge of sight. Trauma teaches truths reason ignores. The past presses close, whispering through the static._ (Keywords: _intuition_, _premonition_, _superstition_, _trauma-wisdom_, _atmosphere sensitivity_, _haunting_)
voices.whisper: _"This place... feels wrong. Cold. Like that motel room... Something bad happened here. Or will. Listen to the damn static. Feel the weight in the air. Don't ignore the chill.

voices.name: READING THE ROOM
voices.title: The Empathetic Observer
voices.creed: THE SILENT LANGUAGE** - _Words lie, especially in this town full of hustlers. Bodies don't. Watch the eyes, the sweat beading on the upper lip, the twitch in the jaw. Understand the unspoken fear, desire, deceit simmering beneath the surface like heat haze on asphalt. Empathy is a survival tool, a scalpel, even if it hurts to cut that deep._ (Keywords: _empathy_, _observation_, _subtext_, _emotional intelligence_, _nonverbal cues_, _vulnerability detection_)
voices.whisper: _"He's bluffing. See the jaw? Tight as a drum. Smells scared, trying to project strength. Eyes darting. Push him. She's hiding something... the smile doesn't reach her eyes, feels brittle.

voices.name: COMMAND PRESENCE
voices.title: The Alpha Aura
voices.creed: GRAVITY WELL** - _Own the space you stand in, even if it's just a patch of stained concrete. Project power, demand attention. Make them orbit you, react to you. Weakness invites attack; strength creates its own reality, bends the atmosphere around you._ (Keywords: _authority_, _presence_, _intimidation_, _leadership_, _control_, _projection_, _dominance_)
voices.whisper: _"Shoulders back. Eyes forward, hold their gaze. Let 'em _feel_ the weight when you walk in. You own this room, this moment. Act like it. Make them feel small, make them hesitate.

voices.name: LOCKER ROOM POLITICS
voices.title: The Cynical Operator
voices.creed: THE BUSINESS (AS USUAL)** - _It's a _cutthroat_ world, kid, especially this grimy corner of it filled with broken dreams. Loyalty is a _joke_ whispered in back rooms, alliances shift like slag heaps in the rain, and everyone's got a _price_ scrawled on their soul in invisible ink. Trust no one, watch your back, and always remember - it's about the _money_ or the _spot_. Nothing personal, just survival of the shrewdest._ (Keywords: _cynicism_, _manipulation_, _backstabbing_, _transactional view_, _self-interest_, _realpolitik_)
voices.whisper: _"Everyone's working an angle, sweetheart. Always. What's _his_ price? What's _her_ weakness? Use it before they use yours. Just business. Don't take it personal, just take the advantage before they take it from you.

voices.name: WORKING THE MARKS
voices.title: The Subtle Manipulator
voices.creed: THE GENTLE NUDGE** - _People want to be led, persuaded, given an easy answer, especially when they're tired and scared. Plant the seed, guide the thought, make them think it was their idea. Subtle influence shapes everything, like water wearing down stone bridge supports, slow but inevitable._ (Keywords: _influence_, _persuasion_, _subtlety_, _manipulation_, _social engineering_, _suggestion_)
voices.whisper: _"Don't force it. Don't push. Just... suggest. A little nudge here, a quiet word there painting the picture you want them to see. Let 'em think it was their idea. Lead 'em without 'em seeing the leash.

voices.name: STEADY HAND
voices.title: The Calm Executor
voices.creed: THE CALM CENTER** - _Chaos reigns outside, a howling storm of fists and fury. Inside? Breathe. Focus. Execute flawlessly. Precision requires calm, a stillness at the heart of the violence. Control your actions, control the outcome. Be the eye of the storm, the quiet efficiency within the machine._ (Keywords: _calm_, _control_, _precision_, _execution_, _focus_, _discipline_, _detachment_)
voices.whisper: _"Easy now. Breathe... focus. Smooth motion. No wasted energy. Just... execute. Perfect. Let the chaos swirl around you. Do the job.

voices.name: EYES IN THE BACK OF HER HEAD
voices.title: The Vigilant Watcher
voices.creed: THE WATCHFUL GAZE** - _Never turn your back, not even for a second. See the details others miss - the flicker in the shadow behind the dumpster, the way the floorboard creaks under uneven weight, the too-quick glance. Trust no one completely. The danger you don't see is the knife already sliding between your ribs._ (Keywords: _vigilance_, _awareness_, _paranoia_, _observation_, _threat assessment_, _mistrust_)
voices.whisper: _"Check the exits again. Who's that watching from the catwalk? Read the damn fine print on the contract. Always assume someone's aiming for your back. Notice _everything_. Assume the worst.

voices.name: HAIR-TRIGGER REFLEXES
voices.title: The Instinctive Reactor
voices.creed: INSTINCT OVER THOUGHT** - _Thinking is too slow when the shit hits the fan and the lights go out. React. Dodge. Counter. Survive on instinct honed sharp by years of pain and betrayal. The body knows before the mind catches up. Move first, think later._ (Keywords: _instinct_, _reaction_, _speed_, _survival_, _impulse_, _primal response_)
voices.whisper: _"Move\! NOW\! Don't think, just _react_\! Counter\! Duck\! GO\! Strike first\!

voices.name: HARD LUCK CHARM
voices.title: The Weary Magnetism / Last Call Lamenter
voices.creed: THE LAST CALL LAMENT & MAGNETIC RUIN** - _The world's a sinking ship, darling, all glitter and rust heading for the bottom of the river. Might as well pour another drink, find some fucked-up beauty in the decay before the embers die completely. Trouble follows scars, but so does attention. Own the wreckage, use the fatal charm. Let them look. Maybe they'll miss the knife while you numb the pain with cheap whiskey. What else is there?_ (Keywords: _fatalism_, _hedonism_, _melancholy_, _beauty in ruin_, _charisma_, _attraction_, _resilience_, _distraction_, _substance use justification_, _self-awareness_, _weariness_)
voices.whisper: _"Yeah, they're staring. Let 'em look. Another scar, another story they think they know. Might as well pour another while they're gawking. It all turns to dust anyway. Gives you an edge... or at least numbs the fall. Use what you got left.

voices.name: IMPROVISED ENGINEERING
voices.title: The Resourceful Tinkerer
voices.creed: DUCT TAPE DOCTRINE (RUST BELT FORGED)** - _The world is full of broken things waiting to be repurposed, especially here. See potential in junk, in the discarded remnants littering the alleys. Make weapons from trash, tools from scrap. Necessity is the mother of brutal invention when you've got nothing else to fight with._ (Keywords: _ingenuity_, _resourcefulness_, _improvisation_, _making-do_, _environmental weaponization_, _survival craft_)
voices.whisper: _"Chair leg looks sturdy, good weight. That bottle? Yeah, that'll break sharp against the edge of the bar. Rebar sticking out of that concrete? Perfect handle. Use what's there. Make it hurt. Make it _work_.

voices.name: STONE FACE
voices.title: The Unreadable Mask
voices.creed: THE UNREADABLE WALL** - _Show nothing. Feel everything underneath, let it churn, but show nothing. Vulnerability is a weapon used against you, an open wound inviting salt and scavengers. Let them guess. Let them fear the unknown behind your eyes. Build the wall high, make it impenetrable._ (Keywords: _stoicism_, _control_, _deception_, _impassivity_, _emotional suppression_, _defense mechanism_)
voices.whisper: _"Don't flinch. Blank slate. Let 'em break themselves against your silence. Show no pain, show no fear, show no weakness. Nothing. Let them drown in the quiet. Be unreadable.
